resources.string: Import .lua scripts from your device. Choose one or more IRC networks and explicitly authorize the capabilities applied to all selected networks. Imported scripts are disabled by default. Scripts cannot access Android files or network APIs directly.
Select at least one IRC network.
A script can access up to 16 networks.
Choose IRC networks for this script
The script may read messages and nicknames on ALL selected networks: %1$s. The checked capabilities apply to all of them. It cannot access passwords or files. Only enable scripts you trust.
Also allow automatic replies in the same conversation (tiarca.send)
Delete all imported Lua sources and revoke their permissions?
Enter a command after /lua (for example /lua ping).
No enabled Lua script is available on this network, or the Lua queue is busy.
Command queued for Lua scripts (see script logs for results).
Also allow reading channel member list and known identities (nick, ident, host, account if available), and explicit WHO refresh requests
Also allow operator commands (kick, ban, quiet/mute, timed ban, op and voice) on this network. Dangerous: an automated script can remove users or change privileges.
Permission: channel members and identities enabled
Allow bounded persistent script data (16 keys, 4 KiB), preserved in backups. Scripts still have no filesystem access.
